title: Origin story: Umbralyn
description: Umbralyn was an astronomer who devoted her life to eclipses — the minutes when the sun is crowned in shadow. She learned that during totality, the world's rules loosen: the dead speak, the future shows, the impossible is briefly possible. She chases eclipses across the world, collecting their minutes like jewels.
